_comment: The calls nodeadm makes to a nodeagent (mTLS :7443 on the mesh, client certificate CN nodeadm.control; the nodeagent's certificate is <id>.cluster.portcullis.internal from pki_node and, for a node nodeadm enrolled, carries the serial nodeadm recorded). The nodeagent side (Task 9) answers only nodeadm.control on these routes; POST /v1/etcd/remove-member runs only on a server node, and only for a member whose node is state removed in portcullis-cluster-addresses (review I6: nodeadm holds no etcd key). Bodies are exact (key order as sent).
